style: Programme note: Act II, a freezing tenement garret in Rome, deep winter. A young labourer and the woman who loves him open the tin box of savings and find the paper worthless; grief turns to fury, then to defiant love. Italian verismo opera duet, c.1900. Lyric tenor (the worker) and lyric soprano (the narrator) trade sung verses, uniting for soaring choruses in unison and thirds. Lush late-Romantic Italian orchestration, divided strings, harp arpeggios, woodwind sighs, horns, swelling melodies, rubato, big romantic climaxes, bel canto legato, Italianate vowels, wide vibrato, held top notes, live opera house acoustic, no drums
exclude: rap, spoken word, screaming, hip hop, drum kit, trap, 808, beat, autotune, pop vocals, electric guitar, synth
